newsitem.title: CANADA: Bell Hewlett IBM win post deal.
newsitem.headline: Bell Hewlett IBM win post deal.

text.p: Purolater Courier Ltd said it awarded a C$35 million contract to a team of companies including, Bell Canada, Hewlett-Packard (Canada) Ltd and ISM Information Management Corp update its information systems.

The courier arm of the Canadian postal service said Bell Canada and ISM, a wholly owned unit of International Business Machines Corp will provide networking and data centre services 24 hours a day, while Hewlett-Packard will provide the architecture for the client server.
The contract award was not broken down into amounts for the specific companies.
Bell Canada is a wholly owned subsidiary of BCE Inc and Hewlett-Packard Canada is a wholly owned unit of Hewlett-Packard Co.
